steps.title: College Admin Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator authenticates via development test session and lands on the Course Registration Desk

steps.title: Verify Enrolment Desk Loaded
steps.description: College enrolment desk renders with term, catalogue, and handover sections

steps.title: Select Existing Academic Term
steps.description: Registrar selects the existing 2026 ODD academic term for the admission handover

steps.title: Confirm Term Selected
steps.description: UI confirms the academic term id is bound for handover

steps.title: Enter Programme Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies the programme id for the approved admission conversion

steps.title: Enter Application Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies the approved admission application id that will become the enrolment source

steps.title: Enter Student Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies a dedicated demo student id for this admission conversion (avoids term duplicate collisions)

steps.title: Open Enrolment From Handover
steps.description: POST /api/v1/enrollment/handovers via BFF converts the approved admission into a PENDING enrolment

steps.title: Verify Handover Success Banner
steps.description: UI shows handover saved confirmation after the Java enrolment service persists the PENDING record

steps.title: PostgreSQL Enrolment Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.enrolments contains PENDING row for the demo application id under the pilot tenant
steps.query: SELECT id, status, student_id, application_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND application_id = 'c3010000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND status = 'PENDING'

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated POST to /api/v1/enrollment/handovers with HTTP 401
